children: Apple Hospitality made an updated investor presentation available with August and September 2026 operating statistics and reiterated strong Q2 operating and balance-sheet metrics.
Released investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) with August/September 2026 operating statistics for upcoming conferences and meetings.
Q2 2026 comparable hotels RevPAR +5.3% and adjusted hotel EBITDA margin expanded 120 bps, driving MFFO up 9.0% to $123.4M.
Maintained strong balance sheet: ~27% net debt to total capitalization, $700M available revolver capacity, no significant maturities until 2029.
Annualized dividend $0.96 per share (~6.0% yield as of 8/31/2026) with $57M distributions in Q2 ($0.24 per share).
Active portfolio strategy: 216 comparable hotels, 207 unencumbered, $85–$95M 2026 capex guidance and $209.2M of hotels under contract.
